summary: All six AQCat25 endpoint candidates completed successfully and passed work-side return, chemistry, geometry, domain, and duplicate review; FS-B and FS-C form one strict predicted duplicate pair, and no VASP job has been submitted.

payload.objective: Review the complete AQCat25 screening set for Fe(110) [CH][C][O]* + H* -> [CH][C]OH* + * before selecting VASP endpoint relaxations.
current_evidence: Final jobs IS-B 1292 and IS-C 1293 exited successfully, converged at predicted fmax 0.048229 and 0.036041 eV/A, and their returned manifests passed work-side validation.
All six candidates are optimizer-converged, connectivity-pass, in-domain, atom-order/cell/fixed-atom preserving, and chemistry-aware geometry-pass.
Predicted IS ranking from low to high energy is IS-B, IS-A, IS-C.
Predicted FS ranking from low to high energy is FS-A, FS-C, FS-B.
FS-B and FS-C meet the configured strict duplicate conditions: same site signature, direct relative adsorbate RMSD 0.1427 A, and predicted energy difference 0.0007 eV.
FS-A remains distinct from FS-B/FS-C; the three IS candidates remain distinct under the strict duplicate gate.
payload.one_executable_step: Obtain user review of the six-candidate comparison and select which nonduplicate IS/FS candidates should proceed to separately authorized VASP adsorption relaxation.
payload.submission_boundary: AQCat25 results are prediction-only and cannot enter DFT energy tables. No VASP adsorption, NEB, DIMER, frequency, or energy-registration action is authorized.
done_when: The user selects the VASP endpoint candidates or requests their final structure review images.
Any selected structures receive a fresh VASP input preflight and explicit submission authorization.
